description.name: Entry
description.text: Ten single attacks (0.71 each), grants [Attach Lightning] and [Thunderblade Rush] to the user, grants [Last Stand] to all allies

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%

description.name: Thunderblade Rush
description.text: Grants [Physical High Quick Cast 1] to all allies in the front row after using a Lightning ability

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering
